provenance.tool: tune_table.py of the split kernels' tuning tools (kernel source snapshot 3b377cd), reduced as their merge_table.py does
provenance.measurement: the kernels' standalone runner: whole launch graph, p50 of 100 rounds after 20 warm-up rounds, balanced routes, cold L2, packed cross-NUMA dispatch off (MEGAMOE_XNUMA_PACK=0 from 32 rows per rank; the runner does not pack below that), as the adapter of FlashInfer 0dc6f0785abd runs it; each GPU pinned to the RDMA NIC on its PCIe switch
provenance.setup: EP16 over two hosts of 8 GPUs each (two NUMA nodes of 4 GPUs per host), 156 SMs per GPU
provenance.fields: p50_us: the selected configuration; default_us: the rule-based configuration, same runner; confirm: the same pair on a second route seed
provenance.selection: the tuner's selection per anchor, except 32 rows (see its note); every anchor was then timed through this backend's wrapper with balanced routes and with recorded decode routes, with a reference check of the output
provenance.untuned: anchors that name only the transport keep FlashInfer's rule-based selection for the row buckets above the tuned decode sizes
